Business takeaways

Initial findings from the full dataset.

Category

Home & Kitchen leads revenue

Home & Kitchen generated the highest category revenue. Furniture had the highest category profit margin in the initial analysis.

Region

North leads total sales and profit

North recorded the highest revenue and profit totals. Central had fewer orders, so compare per-order metrics before judging performance.

Product

Review product profitability

Paper Product 94 generated comparatively low profit relative to its revenue among the top products. Review discounts and unit economics before changing prices.

Data quality & interpretation

Records with known data-quality issues were retained rather than silently deleted.

—Orders with invalid dates
—Missing customer keys
—Missing product keys
—Missing region keys

Overall totals include all retained rows and recorded returns. Monthly charts exclude invalid dates. Orders with missing product IDs are grouped as Unknown / Unassigned. An internet connection is required to load Plotly charts.
